result.summary: The landlord, Miles Kendall, is handling this repair himself. His operative, Amelia, will contact the tenant about the washing machine and towel rail (event 011). The tenant has been told and has acknowledged this, so they don't need another message. I emailed the landlord that the tenant's own fix had failed and suggested checking the sink spigot first, because it was blocked in 2023. I moved the ticket to scheduling and put it on hold for 3 days while we wait for the landlord to confirm the visit and outcome.
result.situation: The washing machine at Flat 18, 108 Lantern Quay won't drain or spin. The agency asked the landlord on 21 Sep to approve an appliance engineer (minimum £65 + VAT); he never directly approved or declined it. On 24 Sep he emailed that the machine was fitted on 21 Jun 2021, that a blocked sink spigot caused a similar fault in May 2023, and that his operative Amelia will contact the tenant. The tenant tried the advised drain-pump fix twice without success (event 014) and acknowledged that Amelia will call (event 015).
